verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party rule engine that lets users define event triggers and resulting actions. Tracks are a sequenced task series rather than event-triggered rules, repeating tasks are a recurring schedule rather than event-driven automation, and Zapier is a third-party integration, which is a user-side workaround that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
